# orbivisor_nodes (Data Source)

The cluster's nodes (names for placement rules, HA groups and per-node certificates).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orbivisor_nodes" "all" {}

resource "orbivisor_ha_group" "prefer_first" {
  name  = "prefer-first"
  nodes = [for i, n in data.orbivisor_nodes.all.names : { node = n, priority = 100 - i }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Node names in order.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `cpus` (Number)
- `id` (String)
- `maintenance` (Boolean)
- `memory_mib` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `online` (Boolean)
- `witness` (Boolean)
